answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's basalt. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra delta buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The cedar is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal ceyr4.
